newsitem.title: UK: US broker Prebon expands, buys Oslo-based Nordico.
newsitem.headline: US broker Prebon expands, buys Oslo-based Nordico.

text.p: U.S.-based brokerage Prebon Yamane said on Friday it was expanding its energy activities in Europe by buying Oslo-based brokerage Nordico Energy Products AS.
"The acquisition of Nordico Energy Products AS helps us to build our energy capabilities in Europe," said Steve Miles, deputy managing director of Prebon Yamane UK Ltd.
Nordico's six-man Oslo office will join Prebon's four other offices in New York, Houston, London and Mexico City.
"In London we have a growing team broking natural gas and its derivatives, and whilst the market is less developed in the U.K. we believe we can add useful liquidity and experience.
"Equally as other energy businesses in Europe begin to develop we see a valuable role for a broker who can intregrate a variety of products," Miles said.
It is expected the deal will be finalised on January 2, 1997 when Nordico will begin trading as Prebon Energy AS.
"We are very excited by the challenge and look forward to expanding our business in Europe," said Pete Burass, chairman of Nordico.
